text:
maria: Heads up — saw a spike in egress TLS handshake failures from us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 during the 2026-03-20 03:00Z deploy window. Retries climbed and a few downstream 504s. Opening thread to track postmortem follow-ups and owners.
ops-bot: Deploy started: release/2026-03-20T03:00Z on cluster prod-us-east (job id 8321) :rocket:
jin: quick triage — handshake timeout + SNI mismatch entries in gateway logs. Rough numbers: ~0.8% of connections in the window, concentrated to a small subset of egress proxies (lb-ef-3).
sam: can you paste the small sample of logs? even 5 lines.
jin: sample logs: ```
[03:01:12Z] conn=178923 tls: handshake timeout peer=10.32.4.11 dest=sni=api.partner.eu
[03:01:13Z] conn=178930 tls: fatal: sni mismatch cert=CN=*.partner.eu expected=api.partner.eu
[03:02:45Z] conn=179201 retry queued after handshake timeout
```
emily: fwiw we saw similar pattern a month ago when an upstream load-balancer started serving different cert chains during cert rotation. could be cross-region cert churn + aggressive retry backoffs.
leo: also check MTU, fragmentation sometimes causes weird TLS renegotiation failures across our NAT path. worth ruling out.
maria: proposed action list and tentative owners below — please ack and update ETA.
- A1) Capture full 5m pcap and increase handshake logging on the affected egress proxies (lb-ef-3). Owner: jin. ETA: 2026-03-22 (48h).
- A2) Run targeted synthetic probe from us-east to eu-west with controlled SNI permutations + cert rotation simulation. Owner: sam. ETA: 2026-03-23.
- A3) Validate cert chains served by partner endpoints during rotation window; request partner confirm no intermittent alternate chains. Owner: emily (liaise with partner-engineering). ETA: 2026-03-22.
- A4) Check MTU/path MTU discovery on egress NAT and update MTU if fragmentation is observed. Owner: leo. ETA: 2026-03-24.
- A5) Short-term mitigation: add a graceful TLS handshake retry with exponential backoff + increased timeout on affected route (config flag). Owner: maria. ETA: 2026-03-21 (hotfix).
- A6) Add a recurring monthly "egress TLS handshake" audit and alert for >0.2% transient handshake errors. Owner: leo. ETA: 2026-04-05.
sam: acked. I'll take A2 and start by spinning up probes this morning. noted. :white_check_mark:
jin: acked. I'll collect pcaps and attach permalink to this thread when ready.
emily: acked. I'll reach out to partner SRE and request cert rotation timeline + artifact list.
leo: acked on A4/A6. I'll run MTU tests and add an alert rule for the handshake error rate.
maria: can we add a small canary for the hotfix (A5)? prefer run in two groups: 5% traffic first, 25% second. ops-oncall, can you help coordinate?
sam: ops-oncall is on PTO but i'll ping @ops-oncall to confirm window.
ops-bot: On-call: ops-oncall paged (maria requested) — available 2026-03-20 09:00Z.
jin: if we get pcaps showing TLS alerts like "unexpected_message" or truncated records that points at path fragmentation. will post findings.
emily: if partner confirms rotation overlap then short-term we can add a cache of cert thumbprints and accept both during a 10m window. need approval from security.
leo: security approval: @security-team we may need a temporary relaxation for cert thumbprint acceptance during partner rotation window. tagging for quick review.
maria: security-team: ping — please advise on risk for temporary thumbprint acceptance vs user impact.
sam: small note on rollout: I'll wire up the canary config in prod feature flags so we can quickly rollback.
jin: posted pcap permalink: https://internal-artifacts/pcaps/2176543210-sample.pcap (will expire in 7d).
leo: found evidence of a single fragmented TLS record in the pcap, and MSS on path is 1400 which caused fragmentation when proxies added headers.
emily: partner replied: they had a rolling cert rotation between 03:00-03:06Z and confirmed nothing unusual, but they rotate via blue/green frontends which may have transient chain changes.
maria: interim decision: apply A5 hotfix (longer handshake timeout + backoff) for next 6 hours and monitor. If error rate drops below 0.2% we keep and plan a safer config change.
sam: deploying A5 hotfix to 5% now. Monitor dashboards: infra-tls-handshake-rate, egress-504s.
ops-bot: Canary deploy started: feature/egress-tls-hotfix -> 5% traffic on cluster prod-us-east.
jin: monitoring: handshake error rate dropped from 0.8% -> 0.25% in the 10m after canary. Looks promising.
emily: :eyes: good signal. I'll keep partner looped.
leo: I'll file a follow-up issue to reduce header bloat in proxy (possible root cause for fragmentation). Owner: leo. ETA: 2026-03-30.
maria: thanks all. We'll keep this thread as the canonical follow-up. Please update the action items in the thread when you complete them and post key artifacts (pcap, probe results, partner notes). Next sync at SRE weekly on 2026-03-24 — we'll review progress. :calendar:
sam: noted, will post probe results and dashboard snapshot by EOD.
jin: will attach parsed pcap and tls-alert counts here once analyzed.
emily: reaching out to partner SRE for a short postmortem they can share.
leo: will add the monthly audit rule and create an alert playbook entry.
maria: appreciated. closing for now — ping this thread if you need help or escalate to postmortem if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
